english.title: Wilfully fail to comply with section 38 / 39 or 40 requirement of a weights and measures inspector
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) wilfully failed to comply with a requirement, namely **(..SPECIFY THE REQUIREMENT..) properly made of you by an inspector of weights and measures, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INSPECTOR..), under section

(A)_[38]_
(B)_[39]_
(C)_[40]_

of the Weights and Measures Act 1985
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 81(1)(a) and 84(6) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985.

english.notes: Section 83 of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that in England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
